contract.intent: Record the landed goal-session feature in the recorded contract stack. The code half of the goal-scoped-sessions change is already in force (goal view, goal! met|archive|seed, the goal-met event type, the designated childless goal leg, goal.md doc-SSOT). This leg records that protected change the ann way: journey-format-spec v17 (the goal-session superseding amendment), resource-registry v4 (the reconciliation rows), and AGENTS.md finished as the re-pointed referrer.
acceptanceCriteria: journey-format-spec v17 is a COMPLETE superseding artifact (logical name journey-format-spec, section anchors preserved) capturing the goal-session amendment: the designated childless goal leg as the single leg-root exception to the no-events rule (its allowed root events), the goal-met eventType, the done-without-tasks derivation, goal.md doc-SSOT with the generated node.json, and goal! met|archive with the archive layout

resource-registry v4 is a COMPLETE superseding artifact (logical name resource-registry, section anchors preserved) carrying the two new reconciliation rows in its register (goal-met and the goal-leg root-events carve-out), phrased like the existing rows

superseded events on the v16 journey-format-spec producer and the v3 resource-registry producer carry successor forward pointers; current(journey-format-spec) resolves to the v17 producer and current(resource-registry) to the v4 producer
AGENTS.md names the goal-leg exception and goal! accurately (no duplication of the feature-commit edits) and its deeper-docs rows cite the current producers
ann check and verify hold at the accepted baselines with only the intended recorded deltas; the leg is managed through ann with rationale at its gates
targetAreas: .ann (the recorded contract stack: journey-format-spec, resource-registry, AGENTS.md)
